note: Grounded in the real Easy Form Builder editor UI: fields are selected in the dropzone and edited through the green gear settings panel; form-wide options live in the form/step settings.

ui_pattern.open_field_settings: In the form editor, click the field once to select it, then click its green gear button (⚙, the green "bi-gear" icon on the field). The field's settings panel slides open — on the LEFT side for English/LTR sites, and on the RIGHT side for RTL sites (Persian, Arabic).
ui_pattern.open_form_settings: Click the form title/header area (or the top-level form settings gear); the general form settings panel opens on the same side (left for LTR, right for RTL).
ui_pattern.save: After any change, click the green Save button (✓) at the top of the settings panel to store the form.
ui_pattern.rtl_note: Side note: the settings panel opens on the LEFT for English/LTR and on the RIGHT for RTL languages.

entries.title: Make a field required
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and turn ON the "Required" toggle. Now the visitor must fill it in before submitting.

entries.title: Change a field's label / name
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and edit the "Label" (field name) box at the top of the panel. The label is the text shown above the field.

entries.title: Change the placeholder / example text
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and edit the "Placeholder" box. This is the light grey hint text shown inside the empty field.

entries.title: Change a field's width (put two side by side)
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and set the "Field width" (e.g. 50% for half). Two 50% fields sit next to each other; 100% is full width. On phones fields stack to full width automatically.

entries.title: Add or edit choices (dropdown / radio / checkbox options)
entries.answer: Select the choice field (dropdown/radio/checkbox/multi-select), open its green gear settings, and use the "Options" list to add, rename, reorder, or remove choices.

entries.title: Add help / message text under a field
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and fill the "Help" / "Message" text box. It appears as a small note beneath the field.

entries.title: Change a field's colors (label, text, border)
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and open the color controls (label color, input text color, border color). Pick a preset or a custom color for each.

entries.title: Change a field's height / corner style
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings; use the height option for the input height and the "corner" option to switch between square and rounded corners.

entries.title: Change the 'this field is required' error message
entries.answer: Select the field, open its green gear settings, and edit the custom required/validation message box, so visitors see your own wording when they skip the field.

entries.title: Set allowed file types and max upload size
entries.answer: Select the file field, open its green gear settings, and choose the file category (document, image, audio, video, spreadsheet, or all) and the maximum file size in MB.

entries.title: Delete or duplicate a field
entries.answer: Select the field to reveal its action buttons, then use the trash/delete button to remove it, or the copy/duplicate button to clone it. You can also drag a field to reorder it.

entries.title: Change the form title / name
entries.answer: Open the form/step settings (click the form header area), and edit the form name/title there.

entries.title: Change the thank-you / confirmation message
entries.answer: Open the form settings and find the "Thank you" / confirmation section; edit the message shown to the visitor after they submit.

entries.title: Turn on email notifications for submissions
entries.answer: Open the form settings and enable email notifications, then set the admin email address that should receive each new submission. (Email/SMTP must be configured in Easy Form Builder settings.)

entries.title: Add captcha / spam protection
entries.answer: Open the form settings and enable captcha/spam protection. reCAPTCHA keys are configured in the main Easy Form Builder settings page.

entries.title: Change the submit button text / color
entries.answer: Open the form settings and edit the submit button text and color (and Next/Previous button labels for multi-step forms).

entries.title: Split the form into multiple steps
entries.answer: Add a new Step from the elements/palette; drag fields into each step. Each step becomes a page with Next/Previous buttons. Edit a step's name/icon via its green gear settings.

entries.title: Show/hide fields with conditional logic
entries.answer: Open the form's conditional logic (rules) panel and create a rule: choose a field + condition (is / greater than / …) and an action (show, hide, require, jump to step, …). Conditional logic is a Pro/add-on feature in Easy Form Builder.

entries.title: Embed the form on a page (shortcode)
entries.answer: Use the shortcode [EMS_Form_Builder id=FORM_ID] on any page or post (or the Easy Form Builder block/widget). AISAAutoPilot shows the exact shortcode right after it creates a form.

entries.title: Change the form background / general styles
entries.answer: Open the form settings for the general appearance options (background, label/element/message colors, fonts). Per-field colors are set on each field's green gear settings.
